apaCitation: Berry, R. B. (2003). Sleep medicine pearls (2nd ed.). Hanley & Belfus.
brptReferenceStatus: BRPT currently lists Sleep Medicine Pearls, 3rd Edition. The Guild has a structured 2nd-edition copy and user-confirmed lawful Kindle access to the 3rd edition. Until the 3rd edition is outlined, the 2nd edition may be used as provisional case-based study support with current-authority cross-checks.
bestFor: Case-based clinical reasoning, sleep-study interpretation, monitoring problems, disorders, and treatment choices.
copyrightUse: Use section titles, bibliographic metadata, and original SPG study directions/summaries only; do not reproduce patient cases, questions, discussions, figures, tables, or substantial passages.
interimUsePolicy: Use the 2nd edition now for durable concepts and case-based reasoning. Before learner-facing use of any version-sensitive detail, cross-check and correct it against the applicable current authority.
authorityBoundary: AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls current scoring rules and technical specifications; ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification; current applicable AASM guidelines, practice parameters, protocols, and clinical guidance control testing and treatment details; BRPT current exam documents control exam scope and policy. The 2nd edition must not override any of these sources.
versionSensitiveReviewRequiredFor: sleep-stage and event scoring rules or thresholds
OSA diagnostic, treatment, and longitudinal-management guidance
central sleep apnea classification or treatment
mappingBoundary: Exact question IDs may map by matching this source key in referenceKeys or studyRecommendationKeys, then grouping by taskCode. Because this edition predates current scoring, classification, and several treatment/testing standards, current professional sources control all version-sensitive content.
